blocks.text: Model building pecheeda masail ki saada numaindagi (representation) banane ka amal hai. Aham ajza par tawajjo asal duniya ke masail samajhne, jaanchne aur hal karne mein madad deti hai. Yeh chapter models, bunyadi statistics, data jama karna aur tayyar karna, statistical models banana aur jaanchna, aur data ko tasveeri shakal dena batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Model kya chhor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Ghair zaroori tafseel, ta ke tawajjo masle ke sab se aham hisson par rahe.

items: Model building: pecheeda masail ki saada numaindagi jo aham ajza rakhti hai.
